adminSettings.title: System settings
adminSettings.copy: Secrets are write-only and stay masked after save.

amountLimits.title: Add TXB limits
amountLimits.copy: These inclusive bounds apply to every payment channel.
amountLimits.minimumHint: The smallest top-up members can submit.
amountLimits.maximumHint: The largest top-up members can submit.
amountLimits.rangeInvalid: The maximum must be greater than or equal to the minimum.

adminSettings.savedHint: New values will be used by the next integration request.
adminSettings.keepSecret: Leave blank to keep current value
adminSettings.secretHint: Stored encrypted and never returned in plaintext.

settingHints.renewal_rollover_before_auto_renewal_ena: When enabled, calculated rollover counts toward the balance required for automatic renewal. When disabled, the renewal price must be covered before rollover credit is applied.
settingHints.captcha_turnstile_enabled: Challenge new users on their first panel visit. Both keys are required before enabling; admins retain configuration access.
settingHints.captcha_turnstile_site_key: Cloudflare Turnstile site key configured to allow this panel hostname.
settingHints.captcha_turnstile_secret_key: Server-only secret, encrypted at rest. Leave blank to keep the current key.
settingHints.telegram_pm_enabled: Accept messages only after panel entry verification. Replies and moderation use panel-admin identity.
settingHints.telegram_pm_group_chat_id: Forum supergroup ID. The bot must be an administrator with permission to manage topics.

adminPaymentProfiles.title: Payment profiles
adminPaymentProfiles.copy: Add provider accounts. BEPUSDT channels are checked automatically when the service starts or a profile is saved.
adminPaymentProfiles.channelHint: Choose the channels members can use.
adminPaymentProfiles.discoveryHint: BEPUSDT channels are discovered automatically. Saving an enabled profile verifies its current currencies and networks.
adminPaymentProfiles.deleteDescription: This removes the provider account. Profiles with creating or pending payment orders cannot be deleted.
adminPaymentProfiles.keepCredential: Leave blank to keep the current credential

adminAudit.title: Audit trail
adminAudit.copy: Append-only records for sensitive administrative actions.
adminAudit.noneHint: Changes appear here as administrators use the console.

adminEntitlements.title: Entitlements
adminEntitlements.copy: Review current and historical access, including the owning account.
adminEntitlements.noneHint: Purchases appear here once users select a combo.
adminEntitlements.cancelDescription: The charged TXB amount will be credited back. Active access will be revoked through a synchronization job.
